title: Units of the ind-etale lift
statement:
An element of $H_A(\overline C)$, as constructed in
[def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift], is invertible if its image in $\overline C$
is invertible.

proof.text: Use the existing small category Algebra.ClosedLift.Index A C and its filteredness [lem-exc-closed-lift-filtered]. The existing CommAlgCat forgetful-functor instance preserves filtered colimits, so Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (the representative clause of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise]) gives X and b in X.alg whose colimit image is h. Applying colimit.ι_desc to the defining coconeC identifies the retained map of this representative with X.toC b. Therefore X.toC b is a unit.

source.place: Proof, first sentence: choose a stage representative

proof.text: Let B = Localization.Away b [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom, the algebra version of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-localization-universal-property], extends X.toC to an A-algebra map β : B → C. Its value on algebraMap X.alg B x is X.toC x, by IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq.

source.place: Proof, second sentence: extend the map to the localization; Stacks 00CP

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-finite-presentation-localization], B is etale and hence finitely generated over A. Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial'' supplies a surjection f from A[Fin n] to B. The first isomorphism theorem gives an A-algebra equivalence e : A[Fin n]/ker f ≃ B. Transport etaleness along e.symm and form the index Y with map β composed with e. The algebra map e.symm composed with the localization map defines a morphism g : X → Y: compatibility with C follows from e.apply_symm_apply and the localization lift equation.

source.place: Proof, second sentence: the localization is another indexing object; Stacks 00U1, 00U2

proof.text: The image of b in Localization.Away b is a unit by IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Mapping this unit along e.symm proves that g.hom b is a unit in Y.alg. The cocone equation colimit.w for g identifies its image in the colimit with the image of b, namely h [def-exc-ind-etale-closed-lift]. Mapping the unit along the colimit injection therefore proves IsUnit h.

source.place: Proof, final sentence: exhibit the inverse in the colimit

proof_origin.place: Proof: representative, principal localization, transition, inverse; Lean implementation by F2 uses the existing forgetful-functor preservation instance and transports the localization to the small presentation model with the polynomial-quotient first isomorphism theorem.
